About / Description: Brighton College (Singapore) is a British international private school offering a British curriculum for pupils aged 18 months to 18 years, guided by kindness, curiosity and confidence, with an emphasis on academic excellence, holistic education and personalised support.
Faculties / Schools: Pre-Prep School, Prep School, Senior School, English as an Additional Language (EAL)
Main Fields of Study(Program): IGCSE Programme (Years 10-11): English, English Literature, Biology, Chemistry, Mathematics, Physics, Physical Education, Co-ordinated Sciences, Additional Mathematics, Art, Computer Science, Design Technology, Drama, French, Geography, History, Mandarin Chinese, Music, Spanish; A-level Programme / Sixth Form (Years 12-13): Sciences, Mathematics, Humanities, Languages, Arts and Social Sciences, with examples including Mathematics, Further Mathematics, English Literature, Drama, Music, Design and Technology; Extended Project Qualification (EPQ)
Application Fee: Non-refundable Application Fee required; amount not stated on current admissions page
General Entry Requirement: Complete online application form and submit supporting documents. For Year 7 onwards: interview with Head of School or Deputy Head of School, last 2 years of school reports, CAT4 assessment, additional references/recommendations if required, and SLATE test for English language support. For Sixth Form: CAT4, recent school reports, interview, typically at least six Grade 6/B predictions or equivalent, Grade 6/B minimum in chosen A-level subjects and Grade 7/A for Mathematics and Sciences.
Language Requirement Summary: Documents must be supplied in English or with official translations. English support may be assessed through WIDA, SLATE Plus or SLATE depending on year level; EAL support is available. Sixth Form guidance includes IELTS preparation.
Internship Support: Brighton College Connect alumni network provides mentoring, internships and career advice after graduation
Career Services: Head of Futures provides university and career planning from Year 12 onwards, including UCAS, Oxbridge, Ivy League and international application support, personal statement and interview coaching, admissions test preparation, CV/interview skills, university fairs and alumni career advice.
Notes: Institution is an international school rather than a university; only High School row created. Number of programs counts IGCSE Programme and A-level Programme/Sixth Form.
